        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $beacon_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $beacon_post = "POST / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $header_host = "Host:" fullword ascii
        $header_useragent = "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" ascii
    condition:
        (uint16(0) == 0x1603 or uint16(1) == 0x1603) and
        all of ($beacon_*) and
        $header_host and
        $header_useragent
}

arguments.summary: A network intrusion was detected originating from external IP 198.51.100.23, identified as a Cobalt Strike C2 server. Initial access was likely achieved via a phishing campaign targeting the Finance VLAN (VLAN 20). The compromised host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) exhibited beaconing behavior, attempted Kerberos TGT requests, and performed lateral movement via SMB to the Engineering VLAN (VLAN 40). The threat actor conducted network reconnaissance, but no evidence of data exfiltration or ransomware deployment was found. Containment actions included blocking the C2 IP and the infected host at the firewall, and hardening the compromised endpoint. The initial scan from the external IP against a low-criticality IT asset (WS-IT-101) was benign and unrelated.

timeline.description: External IP 198.51.100.23 performed an Nmap SYN scan against 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101) in VLAN 50. Alert generated (low severity) and blocked by firewall.
Host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) in VLAN 20 established outbound HTTPS connection to 198.51.100.23.
Suspicious rundll32 execution detected on WS-FIN-042 from Temp directory.
SIEM alert triggered: 'ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2' from WS-FIN-042 to 198.51.100.23.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042 to non-DC host, indicating potential credential dumping attempt.
Successful SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50, confirming lateral movement.
Incident response initiated. Firewall rules deployed to block 198.51.100.23 (FW-RULE-0036) and WS-FIN-042 (FW-RULE-0037).
Endpoint scan on WS-FIN-042 detected 'Dropper.Linux.Agent.F' in cron directory. Host hardened via Ansible playbook.
Containment confirmed. No further malicious activity observed.
